    end)
end

local tmxMessages = {
    "CLAN ON TOP 🔥", "FYTER BNEGA? 🤣", "MEH FIRE 🔥",

    "MEH SHARK", "GHOST", "MASTER"
}

local function generateLine()
    if pattern == "" then pattern = "_" end
    local result = ""
    while #result < 150 do
        result = result .. pattern
    end
    return string.sub(result, 1, 150)
end

local function startTMXSpam()
    if saying then return end
    saying = true
    sendChatMessage(targetName .. " SPAMMER STARTED 👑")
    task.wait(0.1)
    
    spamThread = task.spawn(function()
        while saying do
            local randomMsg = tmxMessages[math.random(1, #tmxMessages)]
            -- Ab target name sirf ek hi baar aayega format ke mutabiq: [TargetName] + Message
            local msg = generateLine().."\n"..targetName.." "..randomMsg
            sendChatMessage(msg)
            task.wait(math.max(delayTime, 0.2))
        end
    end)
end

local function stopAll()
    saying = false
    if spamThread then
        task.cancel(spamThread)
        spamThread = nil
    end
    sendChatMessage("SPAMMER STOPPED 🛑")
end

titleText.TextSize = 22

layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)

local function createInput(placeholder, text, order)
    local container = Instance.new("Frame", mainFrame)
    container.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 35)
    container.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 20, 20)
    container.LayoutOrder = order
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", container)
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", container)
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 10, 10)
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

    input.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)

    input.Text = text

    input.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    input.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120)

        TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 0)}):Play()
    end)
    container.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 10, 10)}):Play()
    end)
    return input
end

local function createButton(text, color, order)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", mainFrame)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 40)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = color
    btn.Text = text
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 15
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.LayoutOrder = order
    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", btn)
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local darkenColor = Color3.new(color.R * 0.7, color.G * 0.7, color.B * 0.7)
    local lightenColor = Color3.new(math.min(color.R * 1.2, 1), math.min(color.G * 1.2, 1), math.min(color.B * 1.2, 1))
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = lightenColor}):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = color}):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = darkenColor}):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = lightenColor}):Play()
    end)
    return btn
end

toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
local toggleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", toggleBtn)
toggleStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0)
toggleStroke.Thickness = 2

-- ===== INPUT HANDLING =====
targetInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local text = targetInput.Text
    if text ~= "" then 
        targetName = "[" .. text .. "]"
    else
        targetName = "[TARGET]"
    end
end)

delayInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local num = tonumber(delayInput.Text)
    if num and num > 0 then 
        delayTime = num 
    else

end)

patternInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()

startBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(startTMXSpam)
stopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(stopAll)

local menuOpen = true
toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    menuOpen = not menuOpen
    if menuOpen then

        TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 290)}):Play()

	}) do

	end

--========================================================

local function FindEPrompt(Character)

	if not Character then
		return nil
	end

	for _, Object in ipairs(
		Character:GetDescendants()
	) do

		if Object:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
			and Object.Enabled
			and Object.KeyboardKeyCode ==
				Enum.KeyCode.E
		then

			return Object

		end
	end

	return nil
end

--========================================================
-- FIND DOWNED PLAYER
--========================================================

local function FindDownedPlayer()

	local MyCharacter, MyRoot =
		GetCharacter()

	if not MyRoot then
		return nil
	end

	local ClosestPlayer = nil
	local ClosestDistance = math.huge

	for _, Target in ipairs(
		Players:GetPlayers()
	) do

		if Target ~= Player then

			local Character =
				Target.Character

			if Character
				and IsDowned(Character)
			then

				local Root =
					Character:
					FindFirstChild(
						"HumanoidRootPart"
					)

				if Root then

					local Distance =
						(
							Root.Position -
							MyRoot.Position
						).Magnitude

					if Distance <
						ClosestDistance
					then

						ClosestDistance =
							Distance

						ClosestPlayer =
							Target

					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return ClosestPlayer
end

local function StartOrbit()

	local Character, Root =
		GetCharacter()

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	OrbitOrigin =

	OrbitAngle = 0

	OrbitEnabled = true

	OrbitEnabled = false

	local Character, Root, Humanoid =
		GetCharacter()

	if Root then

-- ==========================================
-- 1. RE-EXECUTION CLEANUP & STATE STORAGE
-- ==========================================
if _G.UniversalHubCleanup then
    pcall(_G.UniversalHubCleanup)
end

local connections = {}
local activeLoops = {true}

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

_G.OriginalLighting = _G.OriginalLighting or {
    Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
    Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
    GlobalShadows = true,
    FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
    FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
}

_G.OriginalGravity = workspace.Gravity
_G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom = LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance
_G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight

Lighting.GlobalShadows = true

-- Spectate Tracer Cleanup Variables
local spectateBeam = nil
local spectateAtt0 = nil
local spectateAtt1 = nil

local function removeSpectateTracer()
    if spectateBeam then pcall(function() spectateBeam:Destroy() end) spectateBeam = nil end
    if spectateAtt0 then pcall(function() spectateAtt0:Destroy() end) spectateAtt0 = nil end
    if spectateAtt1 then pcall(function() spectateAtt1:Destroy() end) spectateAtt1 = nil end
end

-- Custom Highlight & Billboard Containers Cleanup
local customHighlightFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
customHighlightFolder.Name = "UniversalHub_CustomHighlights"
customHighlightFolder.Parent = workspace

local playerHighlights = {}
local npcHighlights = {}

local function clearAllCustomHighlights()
    if customHighlightFolder then
        customHighlightFolder:ClearAllChildren()
    end
    table.clear(playerHighlights)
    table.clear(npcHighlights)
end

_G.UniversalHubCleanup = function()
    activeLoops[1] = false
    
    for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
        if conn and conn.Connected then
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    table.clear(connections)

    removeSpectateTracer()
    clearAllCustomHighlights()
    if customHighlightFolder then customHighlightFolder:Destroy() end

    if workspace:FindFirstChild("UniversalFloatPlatform") then
        workspace.UniversalFloatPlatform:Destroy()
    end

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam and LocalPlayer.Character then
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hum then
            cam.CameraSubject = hum
        elseif hrp then
            cam.CameraSubject = hrp
        end
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    end

    if _G.OriginalLighting then
        Lighting.Brightness = _G.OriginalLighting.Brightness
        Lighting.Ambient = _G.OriginalLighting.Ambient
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = _G.OriginalLighting.GlobalShadows
        Lighting.FogEnd = _G.OriginalLighting.FogEnd
        Lighting.FogStart = _G.OriginalLighting.FogStart
    end

    workspace.Gravity = _G.OriginalGravity
    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = _G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight
    LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom

    if _G.FluentWindow then
        pcall(function() _G.FluentWindow:Destroy() end)
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- 2. EXECUTOR TIER & ENVIRONMENT DETECTION
-- ==========================================
local executorName = "Unknown"
local executorVersion = "Unknown"

pcall(function()
    if identifyexecutor then
        executorName, executorVersion = identifyexecutor()
    elseif getexecutorname then
        executorName = getexecutorname()
    end
end)

local lowerExecutorName = string.lower(executorName)
local isLowLevelExecutor = (
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "xeno") or 
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "delta") or 
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "hydrogen") or
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "fluxus")
)

print("[FluentHeart]: Detected Executor -> " .. executorName .. " | Mode: " .. (isLowLevelExecutor and "Low-Level Compatibility Mode" or "Standard/Medium Mode"))

-- ==========================================
-- 3. SERVICES & CORE VARIABLES
-- ==========================================
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local StatsService = game:GetService("Stats")

local Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

-- Settings & Flags
local walkSpeedValue = 16
local jumpPowerValue = 50
local fovValue = 70

local customCameraZoomEnabled = false
local customCameraZoomValue = _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom

local tpToolEnabled = false
local floatEnabled = false
local qeControlEnabled = true
local floatSpeedValue = 42
local floatBaseY = nil
local floatYOffset = -2

local potatoGraphicsEnabled = false
local fullbrightEnabled = false
local noFogEnabled = false

local customGravityEnabled = false
local customGravityValue = math.floor(_G.OriginalGravity)
local disableSlidingEnabled = false
local instantAirControlEnabled = false

local joinLogEnabled = false
local playerJoinTimes = {}

local lowHpTrackerEnabled = false
local deathListenerEnabled = false
local deathLogs = {}
local lowHpDebounce = {}

local spectatingPlayer = nil
local selectedTpPlayer = nil
local spawnCFrame = nil

-- Sound Configuration System
local soundSettings = {
    LowHP = { Volume = 0.5, SoundId = "rbxassetid://4590657391" },
    PlayerLeft = { Volume = 0.5, SoundId = "rbxassetid://9114220737" },
    General = { Volume = 0.5, SoundId = "rbxassetid://9060817403" }
}

local function playCustomSound(category)
    pcall(function()
        local cfg = soundSettings[category] or soundSettings.General
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.SoundId = cfg.SoundId
        sound.Volume = cfg.Volume
        sound.Parent = SoundService
        sound:Play()
        game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(sound, 3)
    end)
end

local function recordSpawnLocation(char)
    local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
    if hrp then
        task.wait(0.2)
        spawnCFrame = hrp.CFrame
    end
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then
    task.spawn(recordSpawnLocation, LocalPlayer.Character)
end
table.insert(connections, LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(recordSpawnLocation))

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    playerJoinTimes[player] = tick()
end

table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    playerJoinTimes[player] = tick()
end))

local originalMaterials = {}
task.spawn(function()
    local parts = Workspace:GetDescendants()
    local yieldLimit = isLowLevelExecutor and 100 or 250
    for i = 1, #parts do
        local part = parts[i]
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            originalMaterials[part] = part.Material
        end
        if i % yieldLimit == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
end)

table.insert(connections, Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
        originalMaterials[part] = part.Material
        if potatoGraphicsEnabled then
            part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        end
    end
end))

-- ==========================================
-- 4. HELPER FUNCTIONS & LOGIC
-- ==========================================

local function giveTeleportTool()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    if not backpack then return end

    if backpack:FindFirstChild("Teleport Tool") or char:FindFirstChild("Teleport Tool") then return end

    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = "Teleport Tool"
    tool.RequiresHandle = false

    tool.Activated:Connect(function()
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp and Mouse.Hit then
            local currentRotation = hrp.CFrame - hrp.CFrame.Position
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(Mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * currentRotation
        end
    end)

    tool.Parent = backpack
end

local floatPlatform = nil
local function updateFloatPlatform(dt)
    if not floatEnabled then
        if floatPlatform then
            floatPlatform:Destroy()
            floatPlatform = nil
        end
        floatBaseY = nil
        return
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if hrp and hum then
        local hipOffset = (hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) and (hum.HipHeight + 1.2) or 3.0
        local targetY = hrp.Position.Y - hipOffset

        if not floatBaseY then
            floatBaseY = targetY
        end

        if math.abs(targetY - floatBaseY) > 15 then
            floatBaseY = targetY
        end

        if hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
            if targetY > floatBaseY and (targetY - floatBaseY) < 12 then
                floatBaseY = targetY
            end
        else
            if math.abs(targetY - floatBaseY) > 0.5 then
                floatBaseY = targetY
            end
        end

        local verticalSpeed = floatSpeedValue * dt
        if qeControlEnabled then
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, verticalSpeed, 0)
                floatBaseY = floatBaseY + verticalSpeed
            elseif UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, verticalSpeed, 0)
                floatBaseY = floatBaseY - verticalSpeed
            end
        end

        if not floatPlatform or not floatPlatform.Parent then
            floatPlatform = Instance.new("Part")
            floatPlatform.Name = "UniversalFloatPlatform"
            floatPlatform.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
            floatPlatform.Anchored = true
            floatPlatform.CanCollide = true
            floatPlatform.Transparency = 0.9
            floatPlatform.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
            floatPlatform.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
            floatPlatform.Parent = Workspace
        end
        
        local finalY = floatBaseY + floatYOffset
        floatPlatform.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, finalY, hrp.Position.Z)
    end
end

local function isCharacterPart(part)
    local ancestor = part.Parent
    while ancestor and ancestor ~= Workspace do
        if ancestor:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            return true
        end
        ancestor = ancestor.Parent
    end
    return false
end

local function stopSpectating()
    spectatingPlayer = nil
    removeSpectateTracer()

    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if cam and char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        
        if hum then
            cam.CameraSubject = hum
        elseif hrp then
            cam.CameraSubject = hrp
        end
        
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    end
end

local function updateSpectateTracer()
    if not spectatingPlayer or not spectatingPlayer.Character or not LocalPlayer.Character then
        removeSpectateTracer()
        return
    end

    local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetHRP = spectatingPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not myHRP or not targetHRP then
        removeSpectateTracer()
        return
    end

    if not spectateBeam or not spectateBeam.Parent then
        spectateAtt0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
        spectateAtt0.Name = "SpectateAtt0"
        spectateAtt0.Parent = myHRP

        spectateAtt1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
        spectateAtt1.Name = "SpectateAtt1"
        spectateAtt1.Parent = targetHRP

        spectateBeam = Instance.new("Beam")
        spectateBeam.Name = "SpectateTracer"
        spectateBeam.Attachment0 = spectateAtt0
        spectateBeam.Attachment1 = spectateAtt1
        spectateBeam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
        spectateBeam.Width0 = 0.05
        spectateBeam.Width1 = 0.05
        spectateBeam.FaceCamera = true
        spectateBeam.LightEmission = 1
        spectateBeam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
        spectateBeam.Parent = myHRP
    else
        if spectateAtt0 and spectateAtt0.Parent ~= myHRP then spectateAtt0.Parent = myHRP end
        if spectateAtt1 and spectateAtt1.Parent ~= targetHRP then spectateAtt1.Parent = targetHRP end
    end
end

                    table.insert(labels, entry.label)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

crosshair.Name = "ShiftLockCrosshair"
crosshair.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 32)
crosshair.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
crosshair.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
crosshair.BackgroundTransparency = 1
crosshair.Image = "rbxasset://textures/MouseLockedCursor.png"
crosshair.Visible = false
crosshair.Parent = screenGui

-- Textures
local TEXTURE_OFF = "rbxasset://textures/ui/mouseLock_off.png"
local TEXTURE_ON = "rbxasset://textures/ui/mouseLock_on.png"

local isShiftLocked = false

-- Toggle function
local function setShiftLock(enabled)
	isShiftLocked = enabled
	
	if isShiftLocked then
		shiftButton.Image = TEXTURE_ON
		crosshair.Visible = true
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
	else
		shiftButton.Image = TEXTURE_OFF
		crosshair.Visible = false
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
	end
end

-- Render loop for Camera & Character behavior
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local character = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not character then return end
	
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	
	if isShiftLocked and humanoid and rootPart and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
		humanoid.AutoRotate = false
		
		-- Rotate player to face camera direction
		local cameraCFrame = Camera.CFrame
		local lookVector = Vector3.new(cameraCFrame.LookVector.X, 0, cameraCFrame.LookVector.Z)
		if lookVector.Magnitude > 0 then
			rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(rootPart.Position, rootPart.Position + lookVector)
		end
		
		-- Shoulder camera offset

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then ctrl.l = 0 end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then ctrl.r = 0 end
end)

-- Sistema estável de braços fechados
local function setArmsClosed(character)
    if not character then return end
    local ls = character:FindFirstChild("LeftShoulder", true) or character:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder", true)
    local rs = character:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder", true) or character:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder", true)
    if ls and rs then
        ls.Transform = CFrame.new(-0.2, -0.2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-5))
        rs.Transform = CFrame.new(0.2, -0.2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(5))
    end
end

-- Motor Principal de Voo 3D Livre Relativo à Câmera
local function startFly()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    local hrp = character.HumanoidRootPart
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.PlatformStand = true
    end
    
    -- Inicializa instâncias físicas estáveis
    bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bg.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    bg.P = 9e4
    bg.cframe = hrp.CFrame
    bg.Parent = hrp
    
    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    bv.Parent = hrp
    
    -- Vincula o voo ao ciclo de renderização físico estável do Roblox
    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
        
        setArmsClosed(character)
        bg.cframe = Camera.CFrame
        
        -- Se houver movimento nas teclas W,A,S,D calcula vetor 3D perfeito pela mira
        if ctrl.f + ctrl.b ~= 0 or ctrl.l + ctrl.r ~= 0 then
            bv.velocity = ((Camera.CFrame.LookVector * (ctrl.f + ctrl.b)) + (Camera.CFrame.RightVector * (ctrl.l + ctrl.r))).Unit * flySpeed
        else
            bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        end
        
        -- Injeção Física Direta contra Dano de Queda (Bypass NDS Completo)
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
            humanoid.SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
            pcall(function()
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = bv.velocity
            end)
        end
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    flying = false
    if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect() flyConnection = nil end
    if bg then bg:Destroy() end
    if bv then bv:Destroy() end
    
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if character then
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.PlatformStand = false
            humanoid.SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, true)
            humanoid.SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, true)
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
        end
        local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) end
    end
end

local function tween(obj, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end

local function fxPart(shape, size, color, cf, transparency, material, life)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
	p.Shape = shape
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material or Enum.Material.Neon
	p.Transparency = transparency or 0
	p.CFrame = cf
	p.Parent = workspace
	Debris:AddItem(p, life or 8)
	return p
end

local function seq(a, b, c)
	if c then
		return NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, b), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c) })
	end
	return NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, b) })
end

-- layered particle burst: main particles + soft glow flare on top
local function burst(pos, cfg, count)
	count = math.max(1, math.floor(count * state.quality))
	local holder = fxPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, ONE, Color3.new(), CFrame.new(pos), 1)
	local function make(c, n, glowLayer)
		local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		e.Rate = 0
		e.Texture = c.Texture or TEX_SPARK
		e.Color = c.Color or ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		e.Size = c.Size or seq(1, 0)
		e.Lifetime = c.Lifetime or NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2)
		e.Speed = c.Speed or NumberRange.new(20, 40)
		e.SpreadAngle = c.Spread or Vector2.new(180, 180)
		e.LightEmission = c.LightEmission or 1
		e.LightInfluence = 0
		e.Drag = c.Drag or 3
		e.Acceleration = c.Acceleration or Vector3.zero
		e.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-180, 180)
		e.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
		e.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, 0.3), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
		e.Parent = holder
		e:Emit(n)
	end
	make(cfg, count, false)
	if not cfg.NoGlow and count >= 6 then
		make({
			Color = cfg.Color, Texture = TEX_SPARK, Size = seq(3, 7, 0), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.7),
			Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 8), Drag = 4, Spread = cfg.Spread,
		}, math.clamp(math.floor(count * 0.18), 2, 10), true)
	end
	return holder
end

local function glow(pos, color, size, life)
	burst(pos, {
		Color = ColorSequence.new(color), Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(life, life),
		Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, size * 0.3), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, size), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
		Drag = 0, NoGlow = true,
	}, 1)
end

local function addTrail(part, color, life, width)
	local a0, a1 = Instance.new("Attachment"), Instance.new("Attachment")
	a0.Position, a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, width / 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -width / 2, 0)
	a0.Parent, a1.Parent = part, part
	local t = Instance.new("Trail")
	t.Attachment0, t.Attachment1 = a0, a1
	t.Color = ColorSequence.new(color, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	t.Transparency = seq(0, 1)
	t.WidthScale = seq(1, 0)
	t.Lifetime = life
	t.LightEmission = 1
	t.FaceCamera = true
	t.Parent = part
	return t
end

local function shards(pos, color, count, material, speed, size)
	count = math.max(1, math.floor(count * state.quality))
	for _ = 1, count do
		local s = fxPart(
			Enum.PartType.Block,
			ONE * (size or 0.3) * (0.6 + R() * 1.4),
			color,
			CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(R() * 6, R() * 6, R() * 6),
			0,
			material
		)
		local dir = Vector3.new(R() - 0.5, R() * 0.8 + 0.2, R() - 0.5).Unit
		tween(s, 0.8 + R() * 0.5, {
			Position = pos + dir * speed * (0.5 + R()) - Vector3.new(0, 5, 0),
			Orientation = Vector3.new(R(0, 360), R(0, 360), R(0, 360)),
			Transparency = 1,
		})
	end
end

local function light(pos, color, brightness, range, t)
	local p = fxPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, ONE * 0.5, color, CFrame.new(pos), 1)
	local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
	l.Color, l.Brightness, l.Range = color, brightness, range
	l.Parent = p
	tween(l, t, { Brightness = 0, Range = 0 })
end

local function ring(pos, color, endSize, t, startTransparency)

	tween(r, t, { Size = Vector3.new(0.3, endSize, endSize), Transparency = 1 })
end

local function shockSphere(pos, color, endSize, t)

end

local function pillar(pos, color, height, width, t)
	local p = fxPart(Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.2, width, width), color, CFrame.new(pos + UP * height / 2) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2), 0.25)
	tween(p, 0.15, { Size = Vector3.new(height, width, width) })
	task.delay(0.15, function()
		tween(p, t, { Size = Vector3.new(height, 0.2, 0.2), Transparency = 1 })
	end)
end

local function flash(color, t, strength)
	strength = strength or 0.4
	local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
	cc.Brightness, cc.Contrast, cc.TintColor = strength, strength * 0.5, color
	cc.Parent = Lighting
	tween(cc, t, { Brightness = 0, Contrast = 0, TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
	local bl = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
	bl.Intensity, bl.Size, bl.Threshold = strength * 4, 40, 0.8
	bl.Parent = Lighting
	tween(bl, t * 1.5, { Intensity = 0 })
	Debris:AddItem(cc, t + 0.3)
	Debris:AddItem(bl, t * 1.5 + 0.3)
end

local function blurPulse(size, t)
	local b = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
	b.Size = size
	b.Parent = Lighting
	tween(b, t, { Size = 0 })
	Debris:AddItem(b, t + 0.3)
end

local function shake(power, duration)
	task.spawn(function()
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - t0 < duration do
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then
				local k = 1 - (os.clock() - t0) / duration
				hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.new((R() - 0.5) * power * k, (R() - 0.5) * power * k, 0)
			end
			RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
		end
		local char = player.Character
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero end
	end)
end

local punching, baseFov = 0, 70
local function punch(amount, t)
	local c = cam()
	if not c then return end
	if punching == 0 then baseFov = c.FieldOfView end
	punching += 1
	c.FieldOfView = baseFov + amount
	local tw = tween(c, t, { FieldOfView = baseFov }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart)
	tw.Completed:Connect(function() punching -= 1 end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------------
local function decorate(s, fx)
	local function add(class, props)
		local e = Instance.new(class)
		for k, v in pairs(props) do e[k] = v end
		e.Parent = s
	end
	if fx == "big" then
		add("ReverbSoundEffect", { DecayTime = 3, Density = 1, Diffusion = 1, DryLevel = 0, WetLevel = -4 })
		add("EqualizerSoundEffect", { LowGain = 6, MidGain = -2, HighGain = -2 })
		add("DistortionSoundEffect", { Level = 0.25 })
	elseif fx == "deep" then
		add("EqualizerSoundEffect", { LowGain = 10, MidGain = -6, HighGain = -20 })
		add("ReverbSoundEffect", { DecayTime = 4, Density = 1, Diffusion = 1, DryLevel = 0, WetLevel = -6 })
	elseif fx == "crisp" then
		add("EqualizerSoundEffect", { LowGain = -10, MidGain = 0, HighGain = 8 })
		add("ReverbSoundEffect", { DecayTime = 1, Density = 1, Diffusion = 1, DryLevel = 0, WetLevel = -8 })
	elseif fx == "shimmer" then
		add("EqualizerSoundEffect", { LowGain = -12, MidGain = -2, HighGain = 6 })
		add("ReverbSoundEffect", { DecayTime = 4, Density = 1, Diffusion = 1, DryLevel = -2, WetLevel = 0 })
	end
end

local function sfx(id, vol, pitch, fx, delay)
	if not state.sound then return end
	local function go()
		local s = Instance.new("Sound")
		s.SoundId, s.Volume, s.PlaybackSpeed = id, vol or 1, pitch or 1
		decorate(s, fx)
		s.Parent = SoundService
		s:Play()
		Debris:AddItem(s, 8)
	end
	if delay and delay > 0 then task.delay(delay, go) else go() end
end

local function boom(power, delay)
	power = power or 1
	sfx(SND.boom, 1.7 * power, 0.7, "big", delay)
	sfx(SND.bass, 1.4 * power, 0.42, "deep", delay)
	sfx(SND.boom, 1.0 * power, 1.3, "crisp", (delay or 0) + 0.03)
	sfx(SND.snap, 0.9 * power, 0.55, nil, delay)
end

local function zap(pitch)
	sfx(SND.ping, 1.2, 0.4 * (pitch or 1), "big")
	sfx(SND.snap, 1.0, 0.5 * (pitch or 1), "crisp")
	sfx(SND.bass, 0.9, 0.6, "deep")
end

local function shine(vol)
	sfx(SND.ping, vol or 0.9, 2.0, "shimmer")
	sfx(SND.ping, (vol or 0.9) * 0.7, 2.5, "shimmer", 0.08)
	sfx(SND.ping, (vol or 0.9) * 0.5, 3.0, "shimmer", 0.17)
end

local function whistle(dur, p0, p1, vol)
	if not state.sound then return end
	vol = vol or 0.5
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.SoundId, s.Looped, s.Volume, s.PlaybackSpeed = SND.ping, true, vol, p0
	decorate(s, "shimmer")
	s.Parent = SoundService
	s:Play()
	tween(s, dur, { PlaybackSpeed = p1, Volume = vol * 1.5 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
	task.delay(dur, function() s:Stop() s:Destroy() end)
end

local function bodyParts(char)
	local list = {}
	if char then
		for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(list, d) end
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function hideIn(inst)
	if inst:IsA("BasePart") or inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("Texture") then inst.Transparency = 1 end
	for _, d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then d.Transparency = 1 end
	end
end

local function hide(char)
	if char then hideIn(char) end
end

local function freezeParts(char)
	for _, p in ipairs(bodyParts(char)) do
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
	end
end

local function launchParts(char, pos, force, dur, spin)
	for _, p in ipairs(bodyParts(char)) do
		p.Anchored, p.CanCollide = true, false
		local away = p.Position - pos
		away = (away.Magnitude < 0.1) and UP or away.Unit
		away = (away + Vector3.new((R() - 0.5) * 0.6, 0.7, (R() - 0.5) * 0.6)).Unit
		tween(p, dur, {
			CFrame = p.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(R() * spin, R() * spin, R() * spin) + away * force * (0.6 + R() * 0.8),
			Transparency = 1,
		})
	end
end

local function popup(pos, text, color, size)
	local a = fxPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, ONE * 0.2, color, CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)), 1, nil, 3)
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

	l.Text, l.Font, l.TextSize, l.TextColor3 = text, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, size or 26, color
	l.Parent = bb
	local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")

	tween(a, 1.8, { Position = a.Position + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0) })
	task.delay(0.9, function()

end

local function bolt(a, b, thick, color, tr, depth)
	local segs = 10
	local prev = a
	local dir = b - a
	for i = 1, segs do
		local target
		if i == segs then
			target = b
		else
			target = a + dir * (i / segs) + Vector3.new((R() - 0.5) * 9, (R() - 0.5) * 3, (R() - 0.5) * 9)
		end
		local dist = (target - prev).Magnitude
		if dist > 0.05 then
			local seg = fxPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(thick, thick, dist), color, CFrame.lookAt(prev, target) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -dist / 2), tr)
			tween(seg, 0.45, { Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(thick * 0.2, thick * 0.2, dist) })
			if depth < 2 and i > 2 and i < segs - 1 and R() < 0.35 then
				bolt(target, target + Vector3.new((R() - 0.5) * 30, -(6 + R() * 14), (R() - 0.5) * 30), thick * 0.55, color, tr, depth + 1)
			end
		end
		prev = target
	end
end

local function animateJoint(
	joint,
	cframe,
	weight
)

	if not joint then
		return
	end

	local original =
		originalTransforms[joint]

	if not original then
		original = CFrame.identity
	end

	joint.Transform =
		original:Lerp(
			original * cframe,
			weight or 1
		)

end

local function getHardObstacle(direction)

	if direction.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		return nil
	end

	local flat =
		Vector3.new(
			direction.X,
			0,
			direction.Z
		)

	if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		return nil
	end

	flat = flat.Unit

	local origin =
		rigRoot.Position +
		Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)

	return workspace:Blockcast(
		CFrame.lookAt(
			origin,
			origin + flat
		),
		BLOCKCAST_SIZE,
		flat * HARD_BLOCK_DISTANCE,
		rayParams
	)

end

--------------------------------------------------
-- WALL AVOIDANCE
--------------------------------------------------

local function getWallAvoidance(direction)

	if direction.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		return direction
	end

	local forward =
		Vector3.new(
			direction.X,
			0,
			direction.Z
		)

	if forward.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		return direction
	end

	forward = forward.Unit

	local right =
		Vector3.new(
			-forward.Z,
			0,
			forward.X
		)

	local left = -right

	local forwardHit =
		rayHit(
			forward,
			OBSTACLE_CHECK_DISTANCE
		)

	if not forwardHit then

		if turningAroundWall
			and wallTurnDirection
			and time() < wallTurnUntil then

			if not rayHit(
				wallTurnDirection,
				SIDE_CHECK_DISTANCE
			) then

				return (
					forward * 0.35 +
					wallTurnDirection * 0.65
				).Unit

			end

		end

		turningAroundWall = false
		wallTurnDirection = nil

		return forward

	end

	local leftHit =
		rayHit(
			left,
			SIDE_CHECK_DISTANCE
		)

	local rightHit =
		rayHit(
			right,
			SIDE_CHECK_DISTANCE
		)

	if not leftHit and not rightHit then

		wallTurnDirection =
			random:NextNumber() < 0.5
			and left
			or right

		turningAroundWall = true
		wallTurnUntil = time() + 1.5

		return (
			forward * 0.2 +
			wallTurnDirection * 0.8
		).Unit

	end

	if not leftHit then

		wallTurnDirection = left
		turningAroundWall = true
		wallTurnUntil = time() + 1.5

		return (
			forward * 0.2 +
			left * 0.8
		).Unit

	end

	if not rightHit then

		wallTurnDirection = right
		turningAroundWall = true
		wallTurnUntil = time() + 1.5

		return (
			forward * 0.2 +
			right * 0.8
		).Unit

	end

	local side =
		random:NextNumber() < 0.5
		and left
		or right

	return side.Unit

end

local function tryJump(force)

	if catIsDead
		or petting
		or jumping
		or humanoid.Health <= 0 then

		return false

	end

	if time() - lastJumpTime <
		JUMP_COOLDOWN then

		return false

	end

	if not force and not isGrounded() then
		return false
	end

	forceStand()

	lastJumpTime = time()
	jumping = true

	jumpStartedAt = time()
	jumpEndTime =
		time() + MAX_JUMP_TIME

	stopWalk()

	humanoid.JumpPower =
		RECOVERY_JUMP_POWER

	humanoid.Jump = true

	humanoid:ChangeState(
		Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
	)

	task.delay(
		JUMP_CONTROL_TIME,
		function()

			if rig.Parent
				and not catIsDead
				and humanoid.Health > 0 then

				humanoid.JumpPower =
					NORMAL_JUMP_POWER

			end

		end
	)

	return true

end

--------------------------------------------------

local function updateJump()

	if not jumping then
		return false
	end

	local now = time()

	if isGrounded()
		and now - jumpStartedAt >
		LANDING_BUFFER then

		jumping = false

		humanoid.JumpPower =
			NORMAL_JUMP_POWER

		return false

	end

	if now >= jumpEndTime then

		jumping = false

		humanoid.JumpPower =
			NORMAL_JUMP_POWER

		return false

	end

	humanoid:Move(
		Vector3.zero,
		false
	)

	return true

end

	flat = flat.Unit

	local hardHit =
		getHardObstacle(flat)

	if hardHit then

		local right =
			Vector3.new(
				-flat.Z,
				0,
				flat.X
			)

		local left = -right

		local leftBlocked =
			getHardObstacle(left) ~= nil

		local rightBlocked =
			getHardObstacle(right) ~= nil

		if leftBlocked
			and rightBlocked then

			if isGrounded() then

				if tryJump(false) then
					return
				end

			end

			humanoid:Move(
				Vector3.zero,
				false
			)

			stopWalk()

			return

		end

		if not leftBlocked then

			flat =
				(
					flat * 0.15 +
					left * 0.85
				).Unit

		elseif not rightBlocked then

			flat =
				(
					flat * 0.15 +
					right * 0.85
				).Unit

		end

	end

	local movement =
		getWallAvoidance(flat)

	if movement.Magnitude < 0.05 then

		humanoid:Move(
			Vector3.zero,
			false
		)

		stopWalk()

		return

	end

	humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed

	humanoid:Move(
		movement,
		false
	)

	playWalk()

				part1

			local constraint =
				Instance.new(
					"BallSocketConstraint"
				)

			constraint.Name =
				"CatRagdollConstraint"

			constraint.Attachment0 =
				attachment0

			constraint.Attachment1 =
				attachment1

			constraint.LimitsEnabled = true
			constraint.UpperAngle = 45

			constraint.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
			constraint.TwistLowerAngle = -35
			constraint.TwistUpperAngle = 35

	for _, object in ipairs(
		rig:GetDescendants()

			object.Anchored = false
			object.CanCollide = true
			object.CanTouch = true
			object.CanQuery = true

		tostring(deathCause)

		--------------------------------------------------

		local started =
			time()

		local duration = 2.5

		task.spawn(function()

			while rig.Parent
				and time() - started <
				duration do

				local progress =
					math.clamp(
						(time() - started) /
							duration,
						0,
						1
					)

				local smooth =
					progress *
					progress *
					(3 - 2 * progress)

				animateJoint(
					leftShoulder,
					CFrame.Angles(
						math.rad(35) *
							smooth,
						0,
						math.rad(-8) *
							smooth
					),
					1
				)

				animateJoint(
					rightShoulder,
					CFrame.Angles(
						math.rad(35) *
							smooth,
						0,
						math.rad(8) *
							smooth
					),
					1
				)

				animateJoint(
					neck,
					CFrame.Angles(
						math.rad(15) *
							smooth,
						0,
						0
					),
					1
				)

				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

			end

			if rig.Parent then

				ragdollCat()

		end)

		math.clamp(
			age / LIFE_TIME,
			0,

		)

	local smooth =
		progress *
		progress *
		(3 - 2 * progress)

	local newScale =
		START_SIZE +
		(FINAL_SIZE - START_SIZE) *
		smooth

	if math.abs(
		newScale - currentScale

		currentScale =

		and random:NextNumber() <
		FOOD_SEARCH_CHANCE then

		if startFoodSearch() then
			return
		end

	end

	--------------------------------------------------
	-- Water
	--------------------------------------------------

	if WATER_ENABLED
		and random:NextNumber() <
		WATER_CHANCE then

		if startWaterSearch() then
			return
		end

	end

	--------------------------------------------------
	-- Chase
	--------------------------------------------------

	if CHASE_ENABLED
		and random:NextNumber() <
		CHASE_CHANCE then

		if startChasing() then
			return
		end

	end

	--------------------------------------------------
	-- Other behaviors
	--------------------------------------------------

	local roll =
		random:NextNumber()

	if roll < 0.13
		and SMELL_ENABLED then

		startSmelling()

	elseif roll < 0.23
		and GROOM_ENABLED then

		startGrooming()

	elseif roll < 0.31
		and PAW_ENABLED then

		startPawing()

	elseif roll < 0.38
		and STRETCH_ENABLED then

		startStretching()

	elseif roll < 0.46
		and WATCH_ENABLED then

		startWatching()

	elseif roll < 0.54
		and PLAY_ENABLED then

		startPlay()

	elseif roll < 0.62
		and RANDOM_RUN_ENABLED then

		startRandomRun()

	elseif roll < 0.88
		and EXPLORE_ENABLED then

		startExplore()

	else

		startIdle()

	end

end

--------------------------------------------------
-- 🧠 MAIN AI
--------------------------------------------------

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(
	function(dt)

		if not rig.Parent
			or catIsDead
			or not character.Parent
			or not playerRoot.Parent
			or humanoid.Health <= 0 then

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- AGE
		--------------------------------------------------

		updateAge()

		if catIsDead then
			return
		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- DEATH DETECTION
		--------------------------------------------------

		updateDeathCause()

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- ANIMATION
		--------------------------------------------------

		updateLimbAnimation()

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- NEVER SIT
		--------------------------------------------------

		forceStand()

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- PET
		--------------------------------------------------

		if petting then

			updatePetting()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- JUMP
		--------------------------------------------------

		if updateJump() then
			return
		end

		local playerPosition =
			playerRoot.Position

		local distance =
			(
				rigRoot.Position -
				playerPosition
			).Magnitude

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- FLOOR SAFETY
		--------------------------------------------------

		if not isGrounded()
			and not jumping then

			tryJump(true)
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- FOOD SEARCH
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "SEARCHING_FOOD" then

			updateFoodSearch()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- EATING
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "EATING" then

			updateEating()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- WATER SEARCH
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "SEARCHING_WATER" then

			updateWaterSearch()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- DRINKING
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "DRINKING" then

			updateDrinking()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- SNIFF
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "SMELLING" then

			updateSmelling()

			if distance >
				FOLLOW_RESUME_DISTANCE then

				state = "FOLLOWING"
			end

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- GROOM
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "GROOMING" then

			updateGrooming()

			if distance >
				FOLLOW_RESUME_DISTANCE then

				state = "FOLLOWING"
			end

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- PAW
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "PAWING" then

			updatePawing()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- STRETCH
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "STRETCHING" then

			updateStretching()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- WATCH
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "WATCHING" then

			updateWatching()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- PLAY
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "PLAYING" then

			updatePlaying()

			if distance > 25 then
				state = "FOLLOWING"
			end

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- CHASE
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "CHASING" then

			updateChasing()
			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- RANDOM RUN
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "RUNNING_RANDOM" then

			updateRandomRun(
				playerPosition
			)

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- EXPLORE
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "WANDERING" then

			updateExplore(
				playerPosition
			)

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- RECOVERY
		--------------------------------------------------

		if recovering then

			if time() <
				recoveryUntil then

				moveDirection(
					playerPosition -
						rigRoot.Position,
					WALK_SPEED
				)

				updateStuck(
					true,
					dt
				)

				return

			else

				recovering = false

			end

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- TOO FAR
		--------------------------------------------------

		if distance >=
			TOO_FAR_DISTANCE then

			state = "RUNNING"

			moveDirection(
				playerPosition -
					rigRoot.Position,
				RUN_SPEED
			)

			updateStuck(true, dt)

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- RUNNING
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "RUNNING" then

			if distance <=
				RUN_DISTANCE then

				state = "FOLLOWING"

				humanoid.WalkSpeed =
					WALK_SPEED

				return

			end

			moveDirection(
				playerPosition -
					rigRoot.Position,
				RUN_SPEED
			)

			updateStuck(true, dt)

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- FOLLOWING
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "FOLLOWING" then

			if distance <=
				STOP_DISTANCE then

				stopMoving()

				humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0

				lookAt(playerPosition)

				if random:NextNumber()
					< 0.012 then

					chooseIdleBehavior()

				end

				return

			end

			moveDirection(
				playerPosition -
					rigRoot.Position,
				WALK_SPEED
			)

			updateStuck(true, dt)

			return

		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- IDLE
		--------------------------------------------------

		if state == "IDLE" then

			stopMoving()

			humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0

			lookAt(playerPosition)

			if distance >
				FOLLOW_RESUME_DISTANCE then

				state = "FOLLOWING"

				humanoid.WalkSpeed =
					WALK_SPEED

				return

			end

			if time() >= stateUntil then

				chooseIdleBehavior()

			end

			return

		end

	end
)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(
	function(newCharacter)

		character = newCharacter

		local newRoot =
			newCharacter:WaitForChild(
				"HumanoidRootPart"
			)

		playerRoot = newRoot

		rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
			rig,
			character
		}

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- CAT DOES NOT RESET
		--------------------------------------------------

		if rig.Parent
			and not catIsDead then

			jumping = false
			recovering = false
			petting = false

			behaviorTarget = nil

			rig:PivotTo(
				newRoot.CFrame *
				CFrame.new(
					0,
					0,
					-SPAWN_DISTANCE
				)
			)

			state = "FOLLOWING"

			targetPosition = nil

			humanoid.JumpPower =
				NORMAL_JUMP_POWER

			humanoid.WalkSpeed =
				WALK_SPEED

			humanoid.AutoRotate = true

			forceStand()

			if petPrompt then
				petPrompt.Enabled = true
			end

		end

	end
)

--------------------------------------------------

humanoid.Died:Connect(
	function()

		if catIsDead then
			return
		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- Determine cause
		--------------------------------------------------

		if deathCause == "Unknown" then

			local velocity =
				rigRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity

			if velocity.Magnitude >=
				HIGH_SPEED_IMPACT then

				deathCause =
					"High-speed impact"

			else

				deathCause =
					"Unexpected accident"

			end

		end

		catIsDead = true
		state = "DEAD"

		jumping = false
		petting = false
		recovering = false

		targetPosition = nil
		behaviorTarget = nil

		humanoid:Move(
			Vector3.zero,
			false
		)

		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
		humanoid.JumpPower = 0
		humanoid.AutoRotate = false

		stopWalk()

		if petPrompt then
			petPrompt.Enabled = false
		end

		if sound then
			sound:Stop()
		end

		task.defer(function()

			if rig.Parent then
				ragdollCat()
			end

		end)

		print(
			"☠️ Cat died from: " ..
			tostring(deathCause)
		)

	end
)

--------------------------------------------------

task.spawn(function()

	while rig.Parent
		and not catIsDead do

		task.wait(0.15)

		if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			break
		end

		forceStand()

		for _, object in ipairs(
			rig:GetDescendants()
		) do

			if object:IsA("BasePart") then

				object.Anchored = false
				object.CanCollide = true
				object.CanTouch = true
				object.CanQuery = true
				object.Massless = false

				pcall(function()
					object.CollisionGroup =
						"Default"
				end)

			end

		end

		if not jumping
			and not petting
			and state ~= "IDLE"
			and state ~= "SMELLING"
			and state ~= "GROOMING"
			and state ~= "PAWING"
			and state ~= "WATCHING"
			and state ~= "EATING"
			and state ~= "DRINKING"
			and state ~= "STRETCHING" then

			local velocity =
				rigRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity

			local moving =
				humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude
				> 0.2

			if velocity.Magnitude < 0.15
				and moving
				and isGrounded() then

				tryJump(true)

			end

		end

	end

end)
